{
  "project": "kid-learning-lab",
  "what_building": "An adaptive tutoring engine that generates pedagogical prompts for children based on specific skills and learner states. It uses a dual-model approach with embeddings for context and a large language model for generating tutor responses.",
  "pipeline": [
    "learner_state_ingestion",
    "prompt_rendering",
    "embedding_generation",
    "llm_tutor_response",
    "next_step_generation"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "subject",
    "skill",
    "task",
    "context",
    "learner_state"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "tutor_turn",
    "check_question",
    "guiding_question",
    "next_challenge",
    "reflection_prompt"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.92,
  "evidence_quotes": [
    "Task: Teach the skill like a patient tutor: define it simply, walk through the example step by step, then give one quick check question.",
    "Subject: {{subject}} Skill: {{skill}} Task: {{task}} Context: {{context}}",
    "models: {'nomic-embed-text:latest': 32, 'gemma4:31b': 5}",
    "Act as Prof. Fox. Explain concepts simply, use a small example, ask one check-for-understanding question"
  ]
}
